title: FUMI Tangy Apple Nicotine Pouches - 8mg per Pouch
description: FUMi Tangy Apple Strong Nicotine Pouches offer a balanced Apple profile with both sweetness and bite. Red and green Apple notes combine for a crisp, refreshing flavour that feels clean and easy to enjoy all day. Each slim, all-white pouch fits discreetly under the lip and delivers a gradual release of 8mg nicotine alongside its fruit flavour for up to 30 minutes. With no smoke, vapour or odour, these pouches are ideal for discreet, on-the-go use. Each can contains 20 pouches made from soft plant-based fibres and manufactured in Sweden by Helix AB. Nicotine Range: Strong - 8mg this is suited for more experienced users. How to Use Nicotine Pouches: Please Note: DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
